assessment.summary: This study monitored the frequency and mechanisms of pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii in 13 villages in Plateau Department, Benin, from 2012 to 2014. The authors report high frequencies of the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation, which was near fixation in both species. Vgsc L1014S (L995S) was not detected. Phenotypic resistance to deltamethrin was widespread, and metabolic resistance (CYP6P3, CYP6M2, GSTD3) was also investigated.
